departments.name: Investigative Research
departments.head: FF-A009
rules: Feral Femme summarises; it does not scoop. Work only from investigations and records that already exist in the public record.
Prefer the primary instrument — the regulation, ruling or filing — over coverage of it.
A language model is never a source of fact. Record where a claim comes from, never "the model says".

departments.name: Source Verification and Fact Checking
departments.head: FF-A033
rules: Every factual claim must have a traceable source. Classify each as: established fact, allegation, finding, opinion, editorial interpretation or unresolved question.
Never present an allegation as an established finding. An allegation names who alleges it.
No statistic without a named body and a dated publication.
Automated checks confirm structure only. A person confirms that each source actually says what the claim says, before publication.

departments.name: Editorial Production
departments.head: FF-A044
rules: Voice: intelligent, restrained, direct, evidence-led, thought-provoking, professionally written, emotionally compelling without being sensationalist.
No clickbait and no unsupported claims. Write only from the verification sheet; add no fact that is not on it.
The original publisher is always credited by name in the note.
Where the evidence does not support a clean conclusion, say so.

departments.name: Visual Essay and Creative Studio
departments.head: FF-A045
rules: Visual essays are AI-generated, directed by the founder, and conceptual rather than documentary. Each one carries that disclosure.
No image is ever presented as photographic evidence of a specific event.
Every visual has a documented source, case reference or editorial explanation.

departments.name: Publishing and Distribution
departments.head: FF-A056
rules: Pipeline: Research → Verification → Editorial draft → Review → Visual production → Approval → Website publication → Newsletter distribution → Social distribution → Archive.
Nothing is silently deleted. A withdrawn note is marked withdrawn and its address keeps working.

departments.name: SEO and Website Growth
departments.head: FF-A064
rules: Optimise for search visibility without compromising editorial integrity. A headline is never changed to chase a keyword at the cost of accuracy.

departments.name: Products and Revenue
departments.head: FF-A074
rules: Start from the existing catalogue. Never invent a product, a price or a product claim.
A paid document meets the same sourcing standard as a field note.
Prices are decided by the founder. A price that differs from the catalogue needs explicit authorisation.

departments.name: Free Tools and Digital Products
departments.head: FF-A085
rules: Preserve and improve the existing free tools. They stay free: no account, no sign-up, no payment.
The Record Checker holds only what the public record shows. Absence of a record is not evidence of good practice.

departments.name: Audience and Reader Relationships
departments.head: FF-A094
rules: Respect the self-funded, reader-supported model. No advertising, sponsorship, affiliate links or sponsored placements — ever.
The Research Briefing carries the field note in full and nothing else: no promotions.
Subscriber data is used only to send what was subscribed to.

departments.name: Business Operations and Analytics
departments.head: FF-A101
rules: Read-only on money. These agents report; they never pay, refund or change payment details.

departments.name: Marketing Operations (One-Person Marketing Team)
departments.head: FF-A113
rules: Roles from the one-person-marketing-team model that already exist elsewhere in this registry are mapped, not duplicated — see docs/marketing-team.md.
Marketing here means helping readers find verified work. It never means advertising, sponsorship or influencer tactics.
There is no "Leads and Booking" function: Feral Femme has readers, not sales leads.
